# ===== PRESET: SOFT & RICH FULL (Soft v2 + online plugin lineup) =====
# Gate -> EQ -> Saturation (Airwindows Density3) -> Compressor (Kotelnikov) -> De-esser (T-De-Esser 2)

# Noise gate (gentle expander: -43 dB, 3:1, 2 ms / 100 ms)
VSTPlugin: Library "ATKExpander x64.dll" Attack 0.097959 Release 1 Threshold 0.531507 Softness 1 Slope 0.142134
# Level (1.5 dB lower than Soft v2 to offset the saturation's gain)
Preamp: 8.5 dB
# Low cut + boom control
Filter: ON HPQ Fc 100 Hz Q 0.707
Filter: ON PK Fc 105 Hz Gain -3 dB Q 1.4
# Chest richness + body
Filter: ON PK Fc 165 Hz Gain 2.5 dB Q 0.9
Filter: ON PK Fc 240 Hz Gain 1 dB Q 1.0
# Scoop mud/boxiness
Filter: ON PK Fc 420 Hz Gain -4.5 dB Q 1.0
# Remove nasal headset honk
Filter: ON PK Fc 1000 Hz Gain -2 dB Q 1.2
# Soft presence
Filter: ON PK Fc 2400 Hz Gain 3.5 dB Q 0.6
# Smooth headset edge + rounded top
Filter: ON PK Fc 4500 Hz Gain -2 dB Q 1.5
Filter: ON HSC Fc 7000 Hz Gain -1 dB

# Saturation: subtle harmonic richness (Density 0.3 on its -1..4 scale, Dry/Wet 60%, about +1.5 dB)
VSTPlugin: Library "Density364.dll" ChunkData "uB6FPgAAAAAAAIA/mpkZPw=="

# Compressor: 2.5:1, 25 ms attack, -30 dB, +6 makeup
VSTPlugin: Library "TDR Kotelnikov.dll" ChunkData ""

# De-esser: T-De-Esser 2 (Processing -28 dB, 4:1, High range)
VSTPlugin: Library "T-De-Esser 2.dll" ChunkData ""
